nodes.label: Custom Domain Configuration
nodes.rationale: Client sets a DNS CNAME to this host; SSL is obtained automatically via Coolify rather than in-app certificate management.

nodes.label: Org White-Label Toggle
nodes.rationale: White-label is documented as an Enterprise entitlement: it removes the 'Powered by AIOS' footer, so the toggle is admin-only.

nodes.label: AIOS Dashboard Shell (base.html)
nodes.rationale: Single Jinja2 parent template for every server-rendered dashboard page: holds all CSS design tokens, sidebar/bottom-nav, org switcher and the {% block content %} seam. Centralising the shell keeps pages free of layout markup.

nodes.label: Dark Theme Design Token System
nodes.rationale: Inline CSS custom properties (--bg, --accent #00e5a0, radii, sidebar widths) plus component classes (card, btn, badge, input, stat-card, empty-state). No external CSS framework - the whole visual language ships inside base.html so branding is one file to audit.

nodes.label: Sidebar Collapse Persistence (localStorage + Ctrl+B)
nodes.rationale: Collapsed state is read from localStorage and applied BEFORE first paint to avoid a flash; toggle also bound to Ctrl+B and desktop-only, with hover tooltips on collapsed nav items.

nodes.label: White-Label Branding Toggle (org_white_label)
nodes.rationale: When an org has white_label enabled the (c) 2026 AIOS footer is suppressed, so Enterprise clients never see AIOS branding.

nodes.label: Coolify One-Click Compose Variant
nodes.rationale: Same topology for 1-click paste installs; differences are published ports instead of Traefik-only routing, a 512MB Redis cap, a pinned Kokoro tag and 16GB RAM recommended when voice-stt is enabled.

nodes.label: Voice Channel Provider Options (selfhosted/elevenlabs/vapi/retell/livekit)
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted is listed first and labelled '$0/min' - the platform prioritises zero marginal cost per call over managed vendor quality.

nodes.label: Compose Profiles (voice, voice-stt)
nodes.rationale: Heavy services are opt-in via profiles so an 8GB VPS can run the core stack; a depends_on crossing profiles was deliberately avoided because it invalidates the project whenever only one profile is active.

nodes.label: AIOS Deployment Topology (postgres, redis, otel, evolution, app, worker, voice)
nodes.norm_label: aios deployment topology (postgres, redis, otel, evolution, app, worker, voice)

nodes.label: Evolution IP Allowlist Hardening (C10)
nodes.rationale: Traefik ipAllowList middleware plus monthly EVOLUTION_API_KEY rotation, so the WhatsApp gateway is not publicly reachable.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Proxy Service (Removed)
nodes.rationale: Deleted from the stack: the active provider is OpenRouter (direct, aios/core/providers.py) and the proxy never started - no master key, 90+ crash-loop restarts consuming a full core plus 512M reserved for nothing. Config kept at deploy/litellm.yaml in case it returns.

nodes.label: Human Handover With SLA Timer
nodes.rationale: Taking the conversation pauses the bot and starts a countdown SLA (default 5 min); a browser Notification fires so a human notices even off-screen.

nodes.label: Client-Side Inbox Filter (channel/assignment/text)
nodes.rationale: Filtering runs in JS over data-* attributes on already-rendered rows instead of round-tripping to the server.

nodes.label: Slack App Manifest (AIOS bot)
nodes.rationale: Replaces ~10 manual clicks in api.slack.com with one import plus one install. OAuth scopes and event subscriptions live on separate pages and scopes only take effect after a reinstall, so a manifest sets both together and removes the forget-step. 'Install to Workspace' stays manual because Slack requires a logged-in human admin.

nodes.rationale: Backend unified diff is preferred; when unavailable the page degrades to a client-side line diff against the previous version or the current editor content.

nodes.label: One-Click Version Rollback (POST /api/agents/{id}/versions/{vid}/rollback)
nodes.rationale: Rollback never rewrites history: it copies prompt/voice/config from the chosen version into the agent and records a new version.
